deviations: Placeholder adaptation (binding per compliance log 2026-07-17 02:10, noted adaptation 1): phase doc section 2.1 says init replaces '{wiki-title}', but templates/AGENTS.md uses double-brace placeholders. init() replaces ALL {{WIKI_TITLE}} and {{SLUG}} occurrences; title defaults to the slug.

Hermetic tests: gates run against a temp workspace (mkdtemp) via the workspace option instead of creating wikis/test-wiki in the repo, and section 5.4's 'wikis/fake-wiki' is created in a temp workspace with the screen's new optional workspace prop. Gate assertions are verbatim from the phase doc; only the root path changed (tests/AGENTS.md permits restructuring when the literal test cannot run cleanly, pass criteria unchanged).

Gate 1.4 table handling: the frozen Phase 0 extractText (pdfjs-dist) collapses column-aligned whitespace, so the golden master's drawn table arrives as plain lines ('Quarter Revenue Growth', 'Q1 $9.8M +4%', ...). Added src/extraction/markdown-tables.ts, a deterministic conservative renderer (same-token-count runs of >=3 lines, no list markers, no sentence punctuation, >=2 trailing digit-bearing rows) that rebuilds markdown tables in place. Every word is preserved; prose, headings, and lists are never converted. The raw phase-1 UAT expectation (table formatted with | characters) is genuinely met.
Added -w/--workspace option to the ingest CLI command (init already had it in Phase 0 scaffolding) for symmetry and hermetic CLI use; phase doc section 2.2 shows ingest without it. Additive only.

Added additive export getPageCount(pdfPath) to src/extraction/pdf.ts (frozen extractText signature and behavior unchanged - Phase 0 tests green). Ingestion needs the page count to plan whole-page chunk ranges; both functions now share an internal openDocument helper with identical loader options.

Document page body starts with '## Extracted Text: Pages X-Y' (the vision 06 section 5 pattern) above the raw text; the phase doc section 2.2 body shows raw text only. Additive; all gate-1.3 strings still match verbatim.
Source page adds a '## Warnings' body section only when warnings exist (frontmatter warnings field is exactly per section 2.4; the golden-master page shows warnings: [] and no section).

State file ingestedAt records the LAST successful ingest of a source (drives the TUI 'Last ingest' display); the source page preserves first ingestion in 'ingested' and tracks rewrites in 'updated'. State shape otherwise exactly per section 2.3.

Extra source files not in the phase doc tree: src/utils/slug.ts (wiki-slug validation + source-slug derivation; init rejects non-kebab-case slugs for path safety), src/utils/paths.ts (workspace/wiki path helpers, forward-slash generated paths), src/tui/hooks/use-wiki-details.ts (PDF count + last-ingest display per section 5.2). No new npm dependencies (gray-matter, ink-text-input, pdf-lib were already installed).

TUI section 5.2 simplification: the wiki list itself is the selector - Enter on a highlighted wiki runs ingest on it (Up/Down to choose) instead of a separate two-control list-plus-buttons layout; PDF count, last-ingest timestamp, spinner, and the 'Extracting text...'/'Chunk X/Y'/'Done!' progress lines are all shown as specified.
